summary: Large upload of customer export files from an analyst's laptop to a personal cloud storage domain.
evidence: 4.2 GB uploaded to a personal cloud storage domain in 40 minutes
User was on notice period per HR
investigation: Reviewed proxy logs and file access logs
Confirmed with data owner that the upload was not approved
actions_taken: Ticket escalated to legal and HR
outcome: Further uploads stopped. Data owner assessed exposure; legal notified.
analyst_feedback: Good to involve legal and HR early. Exfiltration was found by chance in a proxy review.
lessons_learned: Escalate suspected insider exfiltration to legal/HR early
Block the destination and preserve proxy and file-access logs first
detection_gaps: No DLP alert on large uploads to personal cloud storage
